title: Billing Note — Restoration Plan Charge by Installment Interval (Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing)
content:
A reinstatement filing on a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate carries a restoration plan charge that follows the installment interval of the certified policy's Cardinal Billing Account pay plan, that is, the number of months between installment due dates after the down payment.

| Installment interval of the certified policy's billing plan | Restoration plan charge |
|---|---|
| One month | 4.00 |
| Longer than one month | 2.00 |
| No installments (the plan is paid in full) | None |

## Reading the interval

The interval is read from the pay plan of the Cardinal Billing Account that bills the certified policy. A plan that bills every month falls on the first line; a plan that bills every two or three months, for example, falls on the second line; a plan with no installments after the down payment falls on the third.

## Hypothetical examples

- A household paying monthly by card: interval one month, restoration plan charge 4.00.
- A household on a plan billed every three months: interval longer than one month, 2.00.
- A household that paid the term in full: no installments, no restoration plan charge.
